messages:
alex: heads-up — conversion for org/openchat-v2 stalled, saw mismatched .safetensors index after hub download with temporary creds.
cheng: can you paste the error? we saw something similar when tokens were cached.
alex: stack: "IndexError: shard 3 not found in index.json". download log shows a 403 on blob fetch then a retry that pulled an older rev pin.
riley: sounds like the rev-pin dance — downloader reused a cached token and pulled a partial snapshot from a previous commit.
alex: repro steps: 
```
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(repo_id=\"org/openchat-v2\", revision=\"main\", use_auth_token=os.getenv(\"HF_TOKEN\"))
```
We intermittently saw 403 on some .safetensors shards.
cheng: also noticed convert tool appends a key suffix in some runs when it detects a revision change — ends up renaming weight keys with a "_rN" suffix. That plus missing shards produced missing weight keys at load.
marie: config.json ended up with 'chat_template': null after conversion in the failing runs — likely convertbot aborted after detecting missing shards and emitted a minimal config.
convert-bot: convert job 0x7f3: started
convert-bot: warning: missing shard(s) detected, attempting fallback to pinned rev 0a9f...
alex: short-term workaround: clear HF token cache on the runner and force snapshot_download with exact commit id and allow_patterns to pull everything. full snapshot fixed it.
riley: proposal: add retry with fresh auth + strict rev pin to the downloader, and make convert tool validate index.json vs downloaded shard list before mutating weight names.
cheng: concrete fix plan:
- bump huggingface_hub client to avoid token cache reuse
- add preflight verification that all shards listed in index.json are present and checksums match
- make weight key rename idempotent and only apply when an explicit mapping provided
marie: also saw a quantization regression: after conversion+quantize(8-bit) chat outputs lost special token <|system|>, so prompt formatting broke. tokenizer.json seems to get overwritten by fallback path in convert when snapshot incomplete.
alex: opened GH issue #4321 with logs + sample bad tokenizer.json and shard download trace. adding a smoke CI that does a small gen and checks special tokens present.
riley: +1. tagging @sre to clear cached creds on runners and @devex to add the smoke test.
cheng: I will push a patch to convert tool tomorrow with preflight + retry logic and add an explicit validation step before writing config.json.
convert-bot: convert job 0x7f3: completed with warnings
marie: thanks all :heart:
